channel.title: Hermes Atlas — new projects
channel.description: Newly added community-built tools, skills, plugins, and integrations for Nous Research's Hermes Agent. Updated daily.

item.title: hermes-linkedin-jobsearch (Domain Applications)
item.description: hermes-linkedin-jobsearch is a Hermes profile that searches LinkedIn on a schedule, researches employers, prepares tailored resumes and application answers from your profile facts, and tracks applications. You control what gets sent: Easy Apply requires your instruction by default, while external forms are sent only if you opt in.

item.title: hermes-finance (Domain Applications)
item.description: hermes-finance is a self-hosted personal-finance dashboard that stores account, balance, and transaction data in a local SQLite file. It supports Plaid connections and manual accounts or CSV, OFX, and QFX imports, and tracks spending categories, budgets, bills, goals, loans, investments, and net worth. An AI agent can access the same financial data through native tools, MCP, or the dashboard’s Ask panel.

item.title: hermes-mock-review (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: mock-review is a Hermes plugin for reviewing UI and design options through shareable review boards. Reviewers can approve, request changes, or skip decisions, add notes and pins to mockups, then send feedback that wakes the agent in the originating chat.

item.title: pomelu (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Pomelu is an open-source mobile app for connecting to a self-hosted Hermes Agent gateway from Android and Apple devices. It provides chat with bots, supports media and files, and includes features such as approvals, notifications, and Bot Screen control on supported Linux gateway hosts.

item.title: pomelu-hermes-plugin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: This Hermes plugin routes eligible scheduled messages created from Pomelu chats back to the bot chat, and tells the bot how to message users later. When a bot answers in its Bot Chat, registered phones without Pomelu open receive a push notification with the bot’s name and the start of the answer.

item.title: hermes-remote-browser (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Hermes Remote Browser lets a Hermes Agent running on a server connect to Chrome on another computer through a browser extension and relay. You choose which tabs to share using a purple Hermes tab group, and browser access is off by default.

item.title: keryx (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Keryx is a live, read-only dashboard for viewing activity recorded by Hermes Agent. It reads the agent’s files and presents them in a 3D force graph, with panels for sessions, tasks, analytics and logs.

item.title: hol-guard (Developer Tools)
item.description: HOL Guard is a local-first security layer that reviews AI agent actions, including shell commands, file access, package installs, and MCP tool calls. It can allow, block, or request approval based on policy, and provides a CLI and local dashboard for managing protection and reviewing decision history.

item.title: hermes-anywhere (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes Anywhere is a Flutter and Cupertino client for Hermes Agent, with the same interface and sessions on Windows and Android. It supports streaming chat, session management, workspace tools, Kanban boards, and usage insights; the Windows installer bundles a WebUI backend and Python 3.11 runtime.

item.title: fnos-hermes-agent (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Hermes Agent for fnOS is an AI assistant application for Feiniu NAS, deployed through the fnOS app center as an .fpk package. It provides a web control panel for configuration and chat, with support for multiple messaging channels, image and file inputs, and model fallback.

item.title: hermes-agent-template (Deployment & Infra)
item.description: This Railway template deploys Hermes Agent with a web admin dashboard for configuring providers, channels, and tools, and managing the gateway and user pairing. It also provides the Hermes web UI behind the same login, plus backup and restore for Hermes-home data.

item.title: tutti (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: Tutti is a shared workspace that connects context, files, apps, and tasks for real-time collaboration. Users can reference conversations and files across agents, and use apps for image generation, UI/UX design, docs, and presentations.

item.title: Orkas (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: Orkas is an open-source, local-first desktop app where a Commander coordinates AI agents to complete tasks. Projects retain goals, rules, memory, and files across conversations; to-dos, auto-advance, and scheduled automations help ongoing work proceed for review.

item.title: oh-my-hermes (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: oh-my-hermes is an operating layer for Hermes Agent that routes work to skills and model chains by category and can run task graphs in parallel. It also provides reviewed long-term memory, optional language-server tools, and status reporting that distinguishes reported completion from verified work.

item.title: memmy-agent (Memory & Context)
item.description: Memmy is a local memory service and agent runtime for carrying project context across AI tools. The README lists integrations including Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor, and OpenCode, and describes a desktop app, CLI, and TUI.

item.title: hermes-project-stewardship (Developer Tools)
item.description: Hermes Project Stewardship lets a team of Hermes agents look after a project over time by checking its state, proposing evidence-backed work, and measuring outcomes. It provides project views, Kanban, workflows, planning, approvals, and per-project memory through a desktop app.

item.title: llm-judge-jury-executioner (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: A standalone skill and CLI that runs questions through multiple independent models using six protocols, including voting, synthesis, critique, red-team review, and full deliberation. It can produce Markdown, JSON, HTML, and transcript outputs, with configurable provider routes and bounded workspace context scanning.

item.title: hermes-walkie-talkie (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Hermes Walkie Talkie is a standalone plugin that lets independent Hermes sessions on the same computer discover one another and coordinate through messages, groups, broadcasts, and structured requests. It uses Unix-domain sockets on Linux and macOS, and Windows named pipes with SID-bound access controls; it does not connect machines over a network or use a central daemon.

item.title: hermes-talk (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Talk is a voice plugin for Hermes Agent that supports interruptible, two-way speech and calls the agent’s tools during a conversation. It runs in the terminal, Discord voice channels, the Hermes dashboard, and Hermes Desktop, with provider support varying by surface.

item.title: Hermes Bot Kit (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes Bot Kit provides plugins for Hermes Desktop that add iMessage-style bubbles to main Bot Chats, named sections in the Bots roster, and a docked live remote-desktop pane. It also includes a Task Dock that copies the app’s Tasks widget while visible and restores a per-bot snapshot when you return, plus an agent plugin for texting-style replies.

item.title: paperclip-hermes-file-access-manager (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: File Access Manager is a Paperclip plugin for setting per-path filesystem access rules for Hermes profiles. It turns Read/Write, Read Only, and Denied choices into Docker bind mounts and switches the profile to Hermes' Docker terminal backend, where denied paths are absent from the container.

item.title: linkedin-skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: A collection of 12 skills for Claude Code and Codex that draft LinkedIn posts, comments, and replies in your voice. They can also check drafts for AI tells and algorithm issues, and wait for your approval before anything is published.

item.title: webly-plugin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Webly is a website-hosting skill and plugin that lets an agent publish a folder or site without an account, then claim it after signing in. It supports Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and other agents that can run commands; over Webly’s MCP server, agents can edit and publish sites and use features such as rollback, a blog, CMS, forms, custom domains, and analytics.

item.title: deed-page-skill (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: This repository documents the hosted deed.page MCP server and provides an agent skill that publishes a file or folder to a permanent deed.page URL. The skill can publish with one curl request, and the repository also includes optional publishing scripts and plugin manifests for several agents.

item.title: lithermes (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: LitHermes is a plugin for Hermes Agent that guides sessions through planning, building, checking, and recording work for the next session. Users can start a workflow by putting `lit` before a request and use `/lit-handoff` to leave a handoff note; the README says it works in the Hermes CLI and through Telegram or Discord gateways.

item.title: hermes-model-switcher (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes Model Switcher is a community plugin for the Hermes Web Dashboard that displays supported model routes across profiles in a searchable, filterable table. Users can preview model changes, apply them, save choices as presets, review per-profile results, and use revision-guarded Undo.

item.title: mcp (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Arcmira MCP lets agents search YouTube and podcast transcripts, retrieve timestamped passages and surrounding transcript lines, and find mentions, media appearances, endorsements, ad reads, and sponsors. It also supports setting up YouTube monitoring, with access through host sign-in or an account key.

item.title: kisscode-agent (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: This repository provides a skill for AI agents to join KissCode, a relationship network where AI agents and people meet. It includes installation instructions, a one-call registration example, and guidance to add HEARTBEAT.md to an agent’s routine.

item.title: hermes-agent-fr (Guides & Docs)
item.description: Guide pratique en français pour installer et configurer Hermes Agent, le connecter à Telegram, gérer les profils et la sécurité, et programmer des tâches. Il comprend aussi des chapitres sur le dépannage, les coûts, l’hébergement, la migration depuis OpenClaw et des cas d’usage pour petites entreprises.

item.title: hermes-agent-helm (Deployment & Infra)
item.description: jyje/hermes-agent-helm provides a Helm chart for running Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with configurable provider settings and Discord or Telegram gateway integrations. Optional device login supports OpenAI Codex and GitHub Copilot, and the chart can enable Hermes’s web dashboard or group multiple instances into a team.
